results.feature: Unauthenticated list is rejected
results.expected: 401 with error envelope

results.feature: Unauthenticated ingestion is rejected
GET /predictive-alerts returns list envelope with meta
results.expected: 200 {success:true, data:[], meta:{page,limit,total}}

results.feature: GET /stats returns the four summary counters
results.expected: 200 with open, highConfidence, assetsAtRisk, workOrdersCreated (all numbers)

results.feature: GET /facets returns full fixed vocabularies
results.expected: 200 with severities[4], types[9], statuses[5], plus facilities/assets/sources arrays

results.feature: Unknown alert id answers 404
results.expected: 404 error envelope

results.feature: POST creates an alert, Open, with a seeded history entry
results.expected: 201, status Open, id PA-*, history[0] = {from:null, to:Open}

results.feature: Asset name is denormalised onto the alert
results.expected: assetName === "dell Magic book 5"

results.feature: Facility placement is resolved from the asset on read
results.expected: placement with facilityName and locationName

results.feature: Alert against a non-existent asset is refused
results.expected: 400 — well-formed body, rule refuses it

results.feature: Confidence above 100 is refused
Confidence is required — no invented default
results.expected: 422 (the module must never manufacture a confidence score)

results.feature: Unknown severity is refused
A Manual alert cannot claim a detector
results.expected: 400 — attributing a human judgement to a model is refused
results.actual: 400 A manually raised alert cannot name a detector — that would attribute a judgement to a model.

results.feature: An engine alert must name its detector
results.expected: 400 when source is Predictive Engine and detector is absent
results.actual: 400 An alert from "Predictive Engine" must name the detector that produced it.

results.feature: Engine ingestion path stores source and detector provenance
results.expected: 201 with source=Predictive Engine and detector.name recorded

results.feature: Predicted failure before detection is refused
Filter by asset returns only that asset
results.expected: every item.assetId === the requested asset

results.feature: Filter by severity
results.expected: every item.severity === Critical

results.feature: CSV type filter accepts multiple values
results.expected: only the two named types come back

results.feature: minConfidence is a floor, not a filter label
results.expected: every item.confidence >= 90

results.feature: Search matches title, asset name and reason
results.expected: the probe alerts are found by free-text search

results.feature: ?open=true returns only Open and Acknowledged
results.expected: no Dismissed/Resolved/Work Order Created rows

results.feature: A bare `to` date includes that whole day
results.expected: today's alerts are returned when from=to=today (not zero)

results.feature: Facility filter matches assets beneath the scope node
results.expected: 200 with 2 alert(s) for Hyderabad warehouse

results.feature: An unrecognised status is dropped, not refused
results.expected: 200 — a stale bookmark renders a list rather than an error

results.feature: Sorting by severity orders by meaning, not alphabet
results.expected: Critical → High → Medium → Low

results.feature: Stats honour the same filters as the list
results.expected: a per-asset cut is smaller than the estate-wide total

results.feature: assetsAtRisk counts distinct assets, not alerts
results.expected: exactly 1 for a single-asset cut with open alerts

results.feature: confidenceThreshold echoes the cut the card was counted at
results.expected: confidenceThreshold === 95

results.feature: Acknowledge stamps who and when, and appends history
results.expected: status Acknowledged, acknowledgedBy set, history grows to 2

results.feature: Re-acknowledging is idempotent, not an error
results.expected: 200 and the history does not grow

results.feature: Dismissal without a reason is refused
results.expected: 422 — dismissal is the one action nothing else records

results.feature: Dismiss records the reason and the actor
results.expected: status Dismissed with dismissedReason and dismissedBy
results.actual: 200 status=Dismissed reason=QA probe — false positive by=Raj

results.feature: Reopening clears the dismissal it reverses
results.expected: status Open and dismissedReason/dismissedBy cleared

results.feature: Open cannot jump straight to Resolved
results.expected: 400 — the transition table does not allow Open → Resolved
results.actual: 400 A Open alert cannot be moved to Resolved.

results.feature: Create Work Order returns a real WO id and moves the alert
results.expected: 201, workOrderId matching WO-*, alert status Work Order Created, id linked on the alert

results.feature: The work order exists on the work-order API
results.expected: 200 from GET /work-orders/WO-26, on the alert's asset
results.actual: 200 asset=AST-1 title=QA Probe — compressor failure predicted — Apple Ma

results.feature: It is stamped Predictive / Predictive Maintenance and back-links the alert
results.expected: type=Predictive, source=Predictive Maintenance, description contains [predictive-alert:PA-22]

results.feature: The order inherits the alert's recommendation
results.expected: priority Critical (from the alert recommendation) and a real history entry

results.feature: Pressing Create Work Order twice does not raise two orders
results.expected: 200 (not 201) returning the same WO-26, reused=true

results.feature: workOrdersCreated counts real linked orders
results.expected: workOrdersCreated rose from 0 by exactly 1

results.feature: The order is findable on the board by its source
results.expected: the new order appears in the work-order list filtered by source

results.feature: A dismissed alert cannot raise work until reopened
results.expected: 400 with a message naming the reopen route out
results.actual: 400 This alert was dismissed. Reopen it before raising work against it.

results.feature: Detail returns alert, asset, work orders and asset history in one call
results.expected: alert + asset + workOrders[] + assetHistory[]

results.feature: Linked work orders come back with live status, not just ids
results.expected: workOrders[0] = {id:WO-26, status, priority, assignedTo, dueDate}
results.actual: {"id":"WO-26","title":"QA Probe — compressor failure predicted — Apple MacBook Pro M5","status":"New","priority":"High","assignedTo":"Unassigned","dueDate":"2026-08-22T12:15:11.714Z"}

results.feature: Asset history excludes the alert being viewed
results.expected: the alert itself never appears in its own history panel

results.feature: Signals and recommendation survive the round trip intact
results.expected: 2 signals with labels/values/weights, and the recommendation body

results.feature: An alert that raised work cannot be deleted
results.expected: 400 — deleting it would strand the work order that names it
results.actual: 400 This alert raised 1 work order(s) and cannot be deleted. Dismiss or resolve it instead.
